article_manifest.title: Ticket: France on a war footing against itself!
article_manifest.original_title: Billet : la France sur le pied de guerre contre elle-même !
article_manifest.summary: France is on a war footing against itself. This is to say the least, on the eve of the events planned by several socio-professional organizations in the country tomorrow, Saturday, October 24, 2026. Following the damage caused during the high school demonstrations of October 17, Macron's government decided to mobilize large resources .

article_manifest.title: Military Court of Mopti: 43 cases involving 72 defendants, including 69 soldiers on the docket
article_manifest.original_title: Tribunal militaire de Mopti : 43 dossiers impliquant 72 prévenus, dont 69 militaires inscrits au rôle
article_manifest.summary: The combined hearings of the Criminal Chamber and the Criminal Chamber of the Military Court (TM) of Mopti, for the year 2026, began on Monday, October 19 at the seat of the said court located in Sévaré. A total of forty-three (43) cases involving seventy-two (72) defendants, including sixty-nine (69) military personnel and three (3) civilians are on the docket.

article_manifest.title: RUMOURS ABOUT YOUSSOUF TOLOBA: DAN NA AMBASSAGOU STEPS UP AND CALLS FOR VIGILANCE
article_manifest.original_title: RUMEURS SUR YOUSSOUF TOLOBA : DAN NA AMBASSAGOU MONTE AU CRÉNEAU ET APPELLE À LA VIGILANCE
article_manifest.summary: Bandiagara: Youssouf Toloba's movement denies reports of an arrest or encirclement of its leader and calls for better coordination with the Malian Armed Forces in the fight against terrorism. The flow of unconfirmed information on the security situation in central Mali continues to elicit public reaction . On Tuesday, October 20, 2026, in Yirimadio, Bamako District, Dan Na Ambassagou officials held a press conference to respond to reports of an alleged arrest and possible encirclement of their Chief of Staff, Youssouf Toloba.

article_manifest.title: Dana Ambassagou: “Toloba is neither hunted, nor surrounded, nor attacked…”
article_manifest.original_title: Dana Ambassagou : « Toloba n’est ni traqué, ni encerclé, ni attaqué… »
article_manifest.summary: During a press briefing on Tuesday, the spokesperson for Dana Ambassagou's self-defence movement, Almaouloud Ongoïba, denied rumours about the arrest of Youssouf Toloba by terrorist groups. He took the opportunity to ask the President of the Transition, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces, for special attention on the security situation in Dogon country "Youssouf Toloba, Dana Ambassagou's Chief of General Staff, is neither hunted down, nor surrounded, nor attacked.

article_manifest.title: Bandiagara: one dead and one injured in an attack in Danlekanda
article_manifest.original_title: Bandiagara : un mort et un blessé dans une attaque à Danlekanda
article_manifest.summary: One dead and one wounded by gunfire, this is the result of an attack perpetrated Thursday, October 22 by unidentified armed individuals against the village of Danlekanda, in the commune of Muétoumou, Bandiagara circle. The injured person was on his way to the Bandiagara referral health center. Last week, the village of Dôolo, in the same commune, recorded three deaths in another attack .

article_manifest.title: Mali: 4,880 terrorists put out of action in five months, the army reveals the scale of operations
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : 4 880 terroristes mis hors de combat en cinq mois, l'armée révèle l'ampleur des opérations
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army continues its offensive against armed groups. During his monthly press briefing on Friday, October 23, 2026, Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar Maiga, Director of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces, took stock of the operations carried out by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) According to this report, 4,880 fighters of terrorist armed groups were put out of action between May and October 20, and more than 162 bases, 315 pick-ups and 1,300 motorcycles were destroyed.

article_manifest.title: illabéri: the Minister of Equipment and Infrastructure visits the rehabilitation site of the Farié-Téra axis
article_manifest.original_title: illabéri : le ministre de l’Équipement et des Infrastructures en visite sur le chantier de réhabilitation de l’axe Farié-Téra
article_manifest.summary: Tillabéri, Oct 23 (ANP) – The Minister of Equipment and Infrastructure, Colonel-Major Salissou Mahaman Salissou carried out, this Friday, October 23, 2026, a field visit to the rehabilitation site of the Farié-Téra road as well as at the Garbougna structure. The purpose of this visit was to inquire about the progress of the work and to assess the results obtained .

article_manifest.title: Defense: In the field of military operations, the SDF continues to maintain pressure on armed terrorist groups
article_manifest.original_title: Défense : sur le terrain des opérations militaires, les FDS continuent de maintenir la pression sur les groupes armés terroristes
article_manifest.summary: Despite the relative lull observed recently in the fight against security threats, the defense and security forces (FDS) remain mobilized on the various fronts of military operations where they continue to maintain pressure against armed terrorist groups (AGT) and other organized criminal groups .

article_manifest.title: PRESS BRIEFING: DIRPA reports 4,880 fighters of the Armed Terrorist Groups put out of action during the period from May to 20 October 2026
article_manifest.original_title: POINT DE PRESSE : la DIRPA fait état de 4 880 combattants des Groupes Armés Terroristes mis hors de combat durant la période allant du mois de mai au 20 octobre 2026
article_manifest.summary: Faithful to its meeting with the media, the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA) held its traditional monthly press briefing, this Friday, October 23, 2026, at its premises. The meeting was moderated by the Director of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces, Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar MAIGA, in the presence of an audience of journalists and media professionals .

article_manifest.title: Algeria and Niger sign 'Memorandum of Understanding' to strengthen military cooperation
article_manifest.original_title: L’Algérie et le Niger signent «un protocole d'accord» pour renforcer leur coopération militaire
article_manifest.summary: Since the reconciliation at the beginning of the year between the President of Niger, Abdourahamane Tiani, and that of Algeria, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, Niamey and Algiers have not left each other: in the space of a month, this is the second time that leaders of the armies of the two countries have met. A new exchange that ended this week with the signing of a memorandum of understanding on Algerian-Nigerian military cooperation In addition to the interview with his Algerian counterpart for Defence, Said Chengriha, the Nigerien Minister Salifou Modi was also received by President Tebboune.

article_manifest.original_title: France : Macron dénonce un « attentat terroriste raciste » dans les Yvelines et appelle à l’unité
article_manifest.summary: "These people were targeted because of their color or their supposed religion, and for nothing else," he said. French President Emmanuel Macron denounced Friday a "racist terrorist attack" in the Yvelines, saying that this attack was "a turning point in the life of our Republic and our nation", and calling on the French to show unity. "What happened today was a racist terrorist attack, as described by the national anti-terrorist prosecutor's office, which resulted in six victims," Macron said in Trappes, alongside local elected officials, referring to the attack in the Yvelines department.

article_manifest.title: Security situation: More than 4,880 terrorists neutralized and 162 bases destroyed by FAMa
article_manifest.original_title: Situation sécuritaire : Plus de 4.880 terroristes neutralisés et 162 bases détruites par les FAMa
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 23 October (AMAP) Faced with the press, Friday, 23 October 2026, at the premises of the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar Maiga presented the results of the operations carried out by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). It reported more than 4,880 terrorists neutralized and 162 bases destroyed over the entire period from May to 20 October .

article_manifest.title: Press briefing: the FAMa announce more than 4,880 neutralized terrorist fighters
article_manifest.original_title: Point de presse: les FAMa annoncent plus de 4 880 combattants terroristes neutralisés
article_manifest.summary: The Director of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar Maïga, presented, on October 23, 2026, the results of the operations of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) According to the figures provided, more than 4,880 terrorist fighters were put out of action and 162 bases destroyed during the period from 10 September to 20 October.

article_manifest.title: Africa: Algeria and Niger sign "a memorandum of understanding" to strengthen their military cooperation
article_manifest.original_title: Afrique: L'Algérie et le Niger signent «un protocole d'accord» pour renforcer leur coopération militaire
article_manifest.summary: The rapprochement between Algeria and Niger continues. After the visit of the President and the Prime Minister of Niger, the Minister of Defence was welcomed on 21 October in Algiers. With his Algerian counterpart, they signed a military agreement to strengthen security cooperation between the two countries This meeting comes barely two months after a mutiny in Niamey against the power of President Abdourahamane Tiani who has since received military support from Algiers.

article_manifest.title: Quarterly increase in the colours of the SDS: Burkinabe Customs at the rendezvous of patriotic duty

This solemn meeting, marked by patriotism and brotherhood of arms, was held in a context marked by the commemoration of the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces .

article_manifest.original_title: Mali – Türkiye : L’Ambassadeur Efe CEYLAN reçu par le Ministre Daoud Aly MOHAMMEDINE pour consolider la coopération de défense
article_manifest.summary: COOPERATION MALI TÜRKİYÉ: TOWARDS A STRENGTHENING OF the PARTNERSHIP IN the FIELD OF SECURITY The strengthening of security cooperation between Mali and Türkiye was at the heart of the audience granted, this Thursday, October 22, 2026, by the Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly MOHAMMEDINE, to His Excellency Mr. Efe CEYLAN, Ambassador of the Republic of Türkiyé in Mali .

article_manifest.title: Mali Army, Russian Fighters Accused of Civilian Killings
article_manifest.original_title: Mali Army, Russian Fighters Accused of Civilian Killings
article_manifest.summary: Human Rights Watch has accused Mali's armed forces and Russia-controlled Africa Corps of committing serious abuses against civilians in the central Mopti region during renewed fighting. The organisation said an apparent military drone strike on September 16 killed eight civilians and injured at least six others in Guélédié village. Witnesses reported that the strike hit an area where residents had gathered to access satellite internet, although armed fighters linked to al-Qaeda were reportedly present in the village.

article_manifest.original_title: Mali – Qatar : Le Général Daoud Aly Mohammedine et le diplomate qatari échangent sur la coopération sécuritaire
article_manifest.summary: MALI QATAR: TOWARDS STRENGTHENING SECURITY COOPERATION The Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly MOHAMMEDINE, received in audience, this Thursday, October 22, 2026, His Excellency Ahmed Turki A. A. ALSOBAI, new Ambassador of the State of Qatar in Mali .

article_manifest.title: Algeria-Niger: a military agreement that confirms the return of Algiers to the Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: Algérie–Niger : un accord militaire qui confirme le retour en force d’Alger au Sahel
article_manifest.summary: Algeria and Niger signed a memorandum of understanding on military cooperation on the occasion of the visit to Algiers of the Nigerien Minister of Defence, General Salifou Mody. This rapprochement comes in a context of recomposition of security alliances in the Sahel, where Algiers seeks to consolidate its influence with the countries of the Alliance of Sahelian States (AES) Algeria and Niger have taken a new step in their security rapprochement with the signing, on Wednesday 21 October 2026 in Algiers, of a memorandum of understanding on military cooperation.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Army, Russia's 'Africa Corps' Commit New Abuses
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Army, Russia's 'Africa Corps' Commit New Abuses
article_manifest.summary: Nairobi — Unlawful Drone Strike, Torture of Civilians in Mopti Region Mali's armed forces and the allied Russia-controlled Africa Corps have committed new atrocities against civilians in central Mali during renewed fighting, Human Rights Watch said today. On September 16, 2026, an apparent military drone strike in Guélédié village, Mopti region, killed eight civilians and injured at least six others.

article_manifest.title: Burkina/Solidarity: A member of the diaspora provides support to widows and orphans who are victims of the war
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina/Solidarité : Un membre de la diaspora apporte un soutien aux veuves et aux orphelins victimes de la guerre
article_manifest.summary: Burkina/Solidarity: A member of the diaspora provides support to widows and orphans victims of the war ASVOVIG staff and donors In a show of solidarity with families affected by the war, Abdoul Dramane Guinko, a member of the Burkinabe diaspora, donated food to the Agency for the Support of Widows, Orphans and Victims of War (ASVOVIG), this Friday, October 23, 2026 in Ouagadougou Composed of rice, spaghetti and oil, this donation aims to support the families of war victims.

article_manifest.title: ‎Tenkodogo: Water and forest agents capture a crocodile near a chicken coop and release it into the dam
article_manifest.original_title: ‎Tenkodogo : Les agents des eaux et forêts capturent un crocodile près d’un poulailler et le relâchent dans le barrage
article_manifest.summary: Tenkodogo: Water and forestry officers capture a crocodile near a chicken coop and release it into the dam A crocodile lurking near a chicken coop in a courtyard in the Gommisi neighborhood, opposite the Tenkodogo Gendarmerie Group, was captured without incident on Thursday, October 22, 2026, and then released into the city dam . According to the Burkina news agency that reports the information, it was a resident who gave the alert to the competent services after seeing the reptile in the concession.

article_manifest.title: Mali: More than forty civilians killed on Sunday by armed men
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: More than forty civilians killed on Sunday by armed men
article_manifest.summary: Mali : plus d'une quarantaine de civils tués dimanche par des hommes armés More than 40 civilians were killed on Sunday in attacks carried out by armed men in the Ménaka region of northeastern Mali, causing population displacements, several security, local and civil society sources told AFP on Monday. These bloody attacks, carried out by armed men arriving on motorcycles, targeted, according to these sources, several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, from which the armed movement "Movement for the Salvation of Azawad" (MSA), close to the junta in power in Bamako, originates.

article_manifest.title: Mali: more than forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men, according to security and local sources
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: plus d'une quarantaine de civils tués dimanche par des hommes armés, selon des sources sécuritaires et locales
article_manifest.summary: More than 40 civilians were killed on Sunday in attacks by armed men in the Menaka region of northeastern Mali, causing population displacement, several security, local and associative sources told AFP on Monday. These bloody attacks, carried out by armed men arrived on motorcycles, targeted, according to these sources, several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, from which the armed movement "Movement for the Salvation of Azawad" (MSA), close to the junta in power in Bamako, came.
